summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on gathering and organizing data related to Out-of-Home (OOH) facilities in Brazil. Specific locations were listed, including Electromedia sites at Sao Paolo bus stops, CC, JCD clocks, and another Electromedia site in Rio.

A parent resource or mapping tool was identified as MapaOOH, with the URL provided.
decisions: The primary OOH facility data source/mapping tool is MapaOOH.
